title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct answer, which is (c).

title: Understanding Magnetic Field
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the magnetic field lines circle around the wire carrying current.

title: Use of Right-Hand Rule
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the right-hand rule to determine the direction of the magnetic field.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a clear and concise explanation of the magnetic field's behavior around the wire.

title: Common Misconception
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that the magnetic field is in the direction of the current or radially outward.
